# truenas_filesystem_acl (Resource)

Manages the access control list of a path (filesystem.getacl / filesystem.setacl). TrueNAS orders entries canonically, so `entries` is a set. Destroying the resource leaves the ACL in place.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entries` (Attributes Set) Access control entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `path` (String) Absolute path, e.g. `/mnt/tank/share`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `acltype` (String) `NFS4` or `POSIX1E`. Defaults to what the dataset uses.
- `gid` (Number) Owning group id.
- `recursive` (Boolean) Apply the ACL to everything below `path` as well. Only affects writes; not detected on read.
- `traverse` (Boolean) With `recursive`, cross into child datasets.
- `uid` (Number) Owning user id.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Required:

- `tag` (String) NFS4: `owner@`, `group@`, `everyone@`, `USER`, `GROUP`. POSIX1E: `USER_OBJ`, `GROUP_OBJ`, `OTHER`, `MASK`, `USER`, `GROUP`.

Optional:

- `advanced_flags` (Set of String) NFS4 individual inheritance flags that are set, e.g. `FILE_INHERIT`.
- `advanced_perms` (Set of String) NFS4 individual permissions that are granted, e.g. `READ_DATA`.
- `default` (Boolean) POSIX1E: a default (inherited) entry.
- `execute` (Boolean) POSIX1E execute permission.
- `flags` (String) NFS4 basic inheritance: `INHERIT` or `NOINHERIT`. Conflicts with `advanced_flags`.
- `id` (Number) User or group id for `USER` and `GROUP` entries.
- `perms` (String) NFS4 basic permission set: `FULL_CONTROL`, `MODIFY`, `READ` or `TRAVERSE`. Conflicts with `advanced_perms`.
- `read` (Boolean) POSIX1E read permission.
- `type` (String) NFS4 only: `ALLOW` or `DENY`.
- `write` (Boolean) POSIX1E write permission.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = truenas_filesystem_acl.example
  provider = truenas
  id       = "/mnt/tank/share"
}
```
